name: callable-contracts
goal: Show each callable contract as its own parameters and return value without renaming API fields

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Prior fix 3cf009b8 relabeled merged module inputs instead of presenting each function API. Expected: callable name, literal parameters and its returned value; no synthetic owner-qualified parameter labels.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Contract tests encoded readable labels in a page fixture without source-derived callable metadata. Extend existing entity contract scenarios with multi-function and single-function API fixtures and assert literal parameters, matching returns and separate per-callable sections.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed tests aa89d87a fail: the existing renderer has no per-callable API region. Immutable checkpoint 1dc08aaf and test-owned screenshots preserve the failure.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Render source-derived callables separately with literal parameters and their own return value. Reuse the field table and example modal. Extend normal contract coverage with source-derived multi-callable, differing return types and zero-parameter/void fixtures.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Opus extracted the canonical contract field table and renders separate callable API sections. Source metadata supplies literal parameters and each return type. Actual casing examples are declared and checked against implementations.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
